svg.title: Shadow Traffic
svg.desc: Shadow Traffic. Mirror live requests to the new version and compare results without affecting users. Step 1, Mirror live traffic: v1 answers every request. The proxy also sends v2 a copy, waits for nothing and drops v2's answer. Step 2, Watch v2 under real load: Real mix, full volume: v2 fails on an empty query, p99 climbs, memory creeps up. No user notices. Step 3, Compare the responses: Mirroring drops v2's answers. A comparator diffs them; two copies of v1 show which fields are noise. Step 4, Keep the shadow harmless: Copy only reads, sample 10%, mark the copies, isolate v2. Once v2 behaves, stop and canary it.

g.text: v1 answers every request. The proxy also sends v2 a copy, waits for nothing and drops v2's answer.
Real mix, full volume: v2 fails on an empty query, p99 climbs, memory creeps up. No user notices.
Mirroring drops v2's answers. A comparator diffs them; two copies of v1 show which fields are noise.
Copy only reads, sample 10%, mark the copies, isolate v2. Once v2 behaves, stop and canary it.
nothing real is charged, sent or changed
The user waits for v1 only
nobody waits for v2; its answer is dropped
A copied write would run twice:
a second charge on the card
a second email to the customer
so: copy only reads, and isolate v2
